    "source": "generative",

    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {

    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "P=80, A=1, R=100, I=9, S=90 (Greek isopsephy) → sum 280; 280 = 2×140, 140 = 4×35",
    "reading": "Number 280 reduces to 10 (2+8+0), the perfect return to unity — a circle closing.",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Paris < Old French Paris < Latin Parisii; possibly from Gaulish *par- 'to make, to shape'",
    "reading": "The shaped place — a city as a deliberate act of making, not accidental growth.",
    "languages": ["la", "cel", "fr"],
    "source": "Ernout-Meillet, Dictionnaire étymologique de la langue latine",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
